goals.name: RIG Realign Loop v1 Weekly Convergence Goal Harness
goals.description: RIG Realign Loop v1 Weekly Convergence Goal Harness [realign-week] — compiled from capabilities/harnesses/rig-realign-v1.yaml
goals.gate: Register validates with zero row errors and the booked_qualified_conversations row present

gates.name: 0.1 Startup phrase spoken and the ISO week key pinned by realign
gates.description: Startup phrase spoken and the ISO week key pinned by realign.week_id() (format %G-W%V), not typed by hand
gates.command: python3 -c "from rig_capabilities.realign import week_id; print(week_id())" output recorded in the session log

gates.name: 0.2 Coordinate stated before any artifact is opened: L4-L5 x D1-
gates.description: Coordinate stated before any artifact is opened: L4-L5 x D1-D2 x A1/A2 x IQRSQPI-10 (Intent Question Research Solution Quality Proof Integrate)
gates.command: Session log line of form 'COORD: L4-L5 x D1-D2 x A1/A2 x IQRSQPI-10'

gates.name: 0.3 Harness tuple H_realign(week, register_delta, gate_verdict,
gates.description: Harness tuple H_realign(week, register_delta, gate_verdict, doctrine_phrase) declared with all four components named
gates.command: Session log contains the tuple declaration verbatim

gates.name: 0.4 The run is declared dry or applied before it starts; `realig
gates.description: The run is declared dry or applied before it starts; `realign` without `--apply` writes nothing, and saying 'dry' does not make a write dry
gates.command: run_week(..., apply=False) returns dry_run true and wrote false; that JSON line is quoted in the session log

gates.name: 1.1 The register is re-read from disk, not carried in memory fro
gates.description: The register is re-read from disk, not carried in memory from last week: capability_register.csv validates with zero row errors, the booked_qualified_conversations row is present at weight 5 in Studio GTM, and every scored row names evidence_paths and enables_product_classes
gates.command: ./bin/rig-capabilities register validate exits 0; register.row_errors returns []; register.require_booked_row raises nothing

gates.name: 1.2 Rows at maturity M4 or above without a named verifier are fl
gates.description: Rows at maturity M4 or above without a named verifier are flagged to their owner and excluded from any improvement claim — an unverified M4 is a scoring bug, not progress
gates.command: register.flagged_owners output printed in full, empty or not; every flagged owner named in the report

gates.name: 2.1 The corpus is scanned once, deterministically, with no model
gates.description: The corpus is scanned once, deterministically, with no model in the classification path, and the unclassified rate is reported against the halt of 0.10 before any score is written
gates.command: convergence.corpus_report(roots=<bounded>) output quoted: raw, unique, unclassified, unclassified_rate, halt

gates.name: 2.2 unclassified_rate > 0.10 stops the week: no C_t, no A_t, no
gates.description: unclassified_rate > 0.10 stops the week: no C_t, no A_t, no delta is published, and the classifier is rebuilt against the held-out set instead
gates.command: score_week raises CorpusHalt/CorpusRefusal and run_week returns verdict CORPUS_REFUSAL with reason unclassified_rate_above_halt; zero artifacts written

gates.name: 2.3 An unreported rate is not a zero rate: a corpus scan that di
gates.description: An unreported rate is not a zero rate: a corpus scan that dies reports corpus_error and the week FAILs rather than inheriting last week's number
gates.command: run_week output carries corpus_error with the exception type and message, and scored.corpus.error is populated; the report quotes it

gates.name: 3.1 C_t and A_t are recomputed in exact arithmetic from the regi
gates.description: C_t and A_t are recomputed in exact arithmetic from the register on disk: E_cap = sum of w_i times (1 minus min(M_i,T_i)/T_i) over active non-duplicate rows with T_i greater than zero, C_t = 1 - E_cap/sum(w_i), A_t = weighted share of rows in bands A1 or A2
gates.command: convergence.e_cap/c_t/a_t Decimal strings quoted verbatim in convergence_report.md, not rounded to a vibe

gates.name: 3.2 Rows with target_M_2031 equal to zero contribute zero and ar
gates.description: Rows with target_M_2031 equal to zero contribute zero and are listed under degenerate_targets — they are never silently divided by
gates.command: metrics.degenerate_targets printed (possibly empty) in the proof JSON

gates.name: 3.3 Score movement passes the anti-gaming gate: RobustMADZ = 0.6
gates.description: Score movement passes the anti-gaming gate: RobustMADZ = 0.6745 * (score - median) / MAD over the C_t series of prior sealed weeks; a MAD of zero is reported mad_zero, not treated as a perfect score
gates.command: convergence.robust_madz output per scored week; flag mad_zero quoted when MAD is zero

gates.name: 3.4 Any flag at or above 5 sigma goes to deep review and blocks
gates.description: Any flag at or above 5 sigma goes to deep review and blocks the PASS while unresolved; a capability jumping three maturity levels in one week is a scoring bug
gates.command: weekly_gate causes list contains the named sigma block and the verdict is not PASS until it is resolved by a re-derived row with evidence

gates.name: 4.1 PASS requires all five: delta C_t strictly greater than zero
gates.description: PASS requires all five: delta C_t strictly greater than zero, delta A_t greater than or equal to zero, unclassified_rate at or below 0.10, at least one qualified booked conversation, and no unresolved flag at or above 5 sigma
gates.command: .context/realign/<week>/proof/weekly-gate.json names every failed condition in causes; PASS with a non-empty causes list is treated as a bug and filed

gates.name: 4.2 A booking counts only when its qualification_evidence_path r
gates.description: A booking counts only when its qualification_evidence_path resolves to a file on disk: load_bookings reports the count and lists invalid records; a generic booked_call row without evidence is zero
gates.command: .context/realign/<week>/proof/bookings.json with count, total, and invalid quoted; bookings count in weekly-gate.json equals the loaded count

gates.name: 4.3 No prior sealed week means BASELINE_ONLY — this week's numbe
gates.description: No prior sealed week means BASELINE_ONLY — this week's numbers are a baseline, never a delta, and never reported as an improvement
gates.command: weekly_gate verdict is BASELINE_ONLY when previous metrics are absent; the report header carries the word BASELINE_ONLY

gates.name: 5.1 The five artifacts are written under .context/realign/<week>
gates.description: The five artifacts are written under .context/realign/<week>/: the register diff, convergence_report.md, the proof JSON directory, doctrine-update-phrase.md (Artifact 27), and operators-weekly.md
gates.command: run_week(apply=True) returns wrote true with exactly those five artifact paths relative to the repo root, and each file exists

gates.name: 5.2 sealed stays false with seal_reason naming the missing seali
gates.description: sealed stays false with seal_reason naming the missing sealing step until a real proof_hash exists — a hash is never typed in by hand to make a week look sealed
gates.command: every proof JSON in the week directory carries sealed false; grep for a truthy sealed value in the week directory returns nothing

gates.name: 5.3 A real zero-booking week is reported FAIL with its cause nam
gates.description: A real zero-booking week is reported FAIL with its cause named, is complete, and is never retried or back-filled; the Doctrine Update Phrase on a FAIL must name the cause rather than describe intentions
gates.command: weekly-gate.json verdict FAIL with causes naming booked_qualified_conversations; doctrine-update-phrase.md contains that cause verbatim

gates.name: 5.4 Escalations fire on the streaks, not on mood: three consecut
gates.description: Escalations fire on the streaks, not on mood: three consecutive FAIL weeks means LOOP_REBUILD_REQUIRED (the loop is the worst-performing harness); three weeks where C_t rises with zero bookings means WEIGHTS_INVALID
gates.command: weekly_gate escalations array quoted; the escalation appears in Operator's Weekly as the week's headline, not in a footnote

gates.name: 6.1 The week is not done because it feels done: Sentinel Prime h
gates.description: The week is not done because it feels done: Sentinel Prime holds fleet termination authority and is specification-only today, so fleet status stays BLOCKED_PENDING_SENTINEL even when a task-level verdict is PASS
gates.command: the week's closing line states fleet status BLOCKED_PENDING_SENTINEL and quotes sentinel_prime_status SPECIFICATION_ONLY from the evidence packet

gates.name: 6.2 System-build PASS never implies business PASS: a green certi
gates.description: System-build PASS never implies business PASS: a green certify on the loop says nothing about bookings, revenue, or convergence, and no sentence in the week's output may imply otherwise
gates.command: Operator's Weekly lists gate verdict, causes, and bookings count from the proof JSON; no line asserts a booking or a revenue figure that load_bookings did not report

preconditions.startup_phrase: I score the week against the register. The register is data on disk; the gate is allowed to say FAIL.
preconditions.bms_bias: A1 deterministic scoring — the gate is code, not opinion; A2 only for writing the Doctrine Update Phrase; A3 forbidden for any score it publishes; A4 forbidden — the loop writes five artifacts under .context/realign/ and takes zero outward action

self_improvement.update_trigger: same weekly-gate cause repeats 3+ weeks → the cause is a register or classifier defect and is fixed there, not re-phrased in the report

success_conditions: Register validates with zero row errors and the booked_qualified_conversations row present
Corpus unclassified rate reported and at or below the 0.10 halt, or the week is CORPUS_REFUSAL with nothing written
C_t, A_t quoted as Decimal strings with degenerate_targets listed
weekly_gate verdict is PASS, FAIL with named causes, BASELINE_ONLY, or a named escalation — never silence
Five artifacts exist under .context/realign/<week>/ with sealed false and a named seal_reason
Fleet status reported BLOCKED_PENDING_SENTINEL while Sentinel Prime is specification-only
failure_states: notes: no PASS is written by this harness — the verdict comes from convergence.weekly_gate and the only emitter of PASS over a claimed commit is dispatcher.admit run by a different model family
halt gate(s) 1.1, 2.1, 2.2, 2.3, 3.1, 4.1, 4.2, 5.1, 6.1, 6.2: no progress without gate evidence
degrade gate(s) 1.2, 3.2, 3.3, 5.3: continue with deficit logged in the Definition of Done waiver

anti_patterns: Publishing a delta C_t with no prior sealed week: that is a baseline wearing a delta's clothes
Counting a booking whose qualification evidence path does not resolve
Rounding an exact Decimal to a number that reads better in Operator's Weekly
Retrying a zero-booking week until it turns green
Writing gate text for a truncated source section because an empty gate looks unfinished

final_rule: A weekly review that produces prose is a diary.
BASELINE_ONLY is honest and is not a PASS.
Zero bookings is a verdict, never a gap to fill in.
Nothing is sealed until a hash exists; sealed false is the truthful default.
Three FAIL weeks names the loop, not the week.

prose: notes: no PASS is written by this harness — the verdict comes from convergence.weekly_gate and the only emitter of PASS over a claimed commit is dispatcher.admit run by a different model family
